name: Unidentified B1 battle droid (C-3PO)
description: A B1 battle droid in the Geonosian droid army served in the Petranaki Arena during the First Battle of Geonosis. The battle droid had its head accidentally grafted onto the chassis of C-3PO when the protocol droid had gotten trapped in the droid factory's conveyor belt system. Meanwhile, C-3PO's own head was grafted onto a B1 battle droid chassis.
